plan.text: Duck DQ with D3. If diamonds continue, take the second round with DA or DK and retain the other stopper; if defenders switch, save both until needed. Once safe, use South’s CA and CK, then lead a low club toward dummy’s CQ when useful, forcing out CJ/CT and aiming to establish a low club for the ninth trick. Cash South’s SA and HA as controls; don’t assume a safe dummy entry through hearts or spades with the opponents’ honors unknown. Reassess after the continuation and club honors appear.

advice.publicReason: D3 is the cheapest duck: dummy cannot beat West’s DQ, and keeping the higher spot cards preserves flexibility while South retains both diamond stoppers.
